texts.zh:
我们的[Owner.GetTerraformerPlural]满意地报告称，我们对[Root.GetName]的环境改造已经完成！通过从最后的巴奥的身体里提取基因并仔细选取出巴奥遗传密码的片段这一方法，我们成功在实验室中制造出了杂种植物并在部署这些植物仅仅五年后就成功完成了对[Root.GetName]气候和大气层的环境改造。

与预期一样，这些杂种植物在行星上到处增殖，目前正进入“潜伏”期，因为[Root.GetName]大气层化学成分的改变使它们不再活跃。

令人难以置信的是，行星管理部门报告称在这一过程里产生了意料之外的结果：[Root.GetName]上出现了许多智慧外星生命！它们与古代的巴奥高度相似，但其拥有广泛混合的此行星自然植被的遗传物质。

尽管不是蜂巢思维的一分子，这些新巴奥外星人似乎同它们的祖先一样平和。无论如何，我们必须妥善解决它们在[Root.GetName]上存在一事。
texts.en:
Our [Owner.GetTerraformerPlural] are pleased to report that the terraforming process on [Root.GetName] has completed! The deployment of new laboratory-created plant hybrids, made using carefully selected segments of the Baol genetic code as harvested from the body of the last Baol, successfully transformed [Root.GetName]'s climate and atmosphere over a mere five-year period.

The hybrid plants multiplied across the planet as expected, and are now entering a 'dormant' phase, as the chemical atmospheric changes on [Root.GetName] have now deactivated them.

 Incredibly, our planetside administration reports an unexpected outcome of the process: a number of sapient aliens, incredibly similar to the ancient Baol, but possessing a vast mixture of genetic material from the planet's natural flora, have appeared on [Root.GetName]!

While not members of a Hive Mind, these Nu-Baol aliens seem as peaceful as their ancestors. One way or another, we shall have to address their presence on [Root.GetName].

The hybrid plants multiplied across the planet as expected, and are now entering a 'dormant' phase, as the chemical atmospheric changes on [Root.GetName] have now deactivated them.

texts.zh:
我们的[Owner.GetTerraformerPlural]满意地报告称，我们对[Root.GetName]的环境改造已经完成！此行星已被环境改造为盖亚星球，这要归功于我们在实验室中制造出的杂交植物的部署，其包含精心选择的巴奥遗传密码的片段。

又一次——作为这一尚未被我们的基因学家完全理解的过程的结果——许多新巴奥人口在环境改造即将完成时于行星上大量出现。
texts.en:
Our [Owner.GetTerraformerPlural] are pleased to report that the terraforming process on [Root.GetName] has completed! The planet has been successfully transformed into a Gaia World, owing to our deployment of laboratory-created plant hybrids, containing carefully selected segments of the Baol genetic code.

Once again, as a result of the process - itself not quite fully understood by our geneticists - a number of Nu-Baol populations have appeared planetside, emerging when terraforming neared completion.

texts.zh:
在[Root.GetName]上引入巴奥幼苗之后产生了惊人的效果。接触幼苗孢子后，我们的一部分人口发生了自主适应，他们在[Root.GetPlanetMoon]上比预期中更加兴旺了。但对他们的生理学分析表明他们如今已无法再适应盖亚以外的其他生态系统了。

令人难以置信的是，行星管理部门报告称这一过程产生了意料之外的结果：[Root.GetName]上出现了许多智慧外星生命！它们与古代巴奥高度相似，但其拥有广泛混合的此行星自然植被的遗传物质。

尽管不是蜂巢思维的一分子，这些新巴奥外星人似乎同它们的祖先一样平和。无论如何，我们必须妥善解决它们在[Root.GetName]上存在一事。
texts.en:
Introducing the Baol seedlings to [Root.GetName] had a most curious effect. After being exposed to the seedling spores, parts of our population now seem to have adapted themselves to thrive even more than expected on the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]. Yet analysis of their biology now tells us that they will not be able to survive outside of a Gaia ecosystem.

Incredibly, our planetside administration reports an unexpected outcome of the process: a number of sapient aliens, remarkably similar to the ancient Baol, but possessing a vast mixture of genetic material from the planet's natural flora, have appeared on [Root.GetName]!

While not members of a Hive Mind, these Nu-Baol aliens seem as peaceful as their ancestors. One way or another, we shall have to address their presence on [Root.GetName].
